scientific_integrity: Infinite-dimensional assertions are established by exact Gram-matrix Fourier symbols, small-frequency asymptotics, and a uniform summable spectral tail; finite rational/numerical checks corroborate rather than replace proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only periodic degree-one uniform splines at half-cell offset. The trace-norm result requires positive macroscopic time; no positivity property of the fourth-order heat kernel is asserted. Older generalized approximation theorems might already subsume parts of the statement; complete historical priority and independent audit have not been established.
title: A trace-class biharmonic limit from alternating half-shifted periodic spline projections
